body: American Heavy Plate Solutions, LLC (AHP) has sued the Monroe County Port Authority and three Bitdeer entities, Erie Creek LLC, Whitetail Creek LLC and Bitdeer, Inc., in the Court of Common Pleas of Monroe County, Ohio. According to a Feb. 5, 2026 SEC filing by parent Bitdeer Technologies Group, Erie Creek received notice of the complaint on Feb. 2, 2026, and AHP seeks declaratory and injunctive relief concerning certain leasehold rights at an industrial property in the county where the port authority is landlord. Bitdeer said it "intends to vigorously defend against the claims." JDJournal described the suit as AHP's claim that Bitdeer and others are violating rights tied to AHP's lease in connection with Bitdeer's data center project.

Bitdeer leases land at the Hannibal Industrial Park in Clarington, Ohio from the port authority under a 30-year agreement announced in June 2024, Cointelegraph reported at the time. In its third-quarter 2026 results, Bitdeer said the timing of power availability and construction at its 570-megawatt Clarington site may be affected by the legal proceedings filed by AHP, a neighboring company, that design and other preparation work continues, and that the site is currently being developed for Bitcoin mining.

In April, Bitdeer moved to disqualify AHP's law firm, which also represents Bitdeer in a separate federal case in New York, arguing the dual role created a conflict and could give the firm access to Bitdeer's private information, JDJournal reported. Judge Julie Selmon denied the motion on Sept. 8, 2026. According to JDJournal, she found it important that Bitdeer had signed an advance waiver allowing the firm to take on certain future matters against it, considered that the firm had kept its Bitdeer lawyers separate from the AHP team, found no evidence that Bitdeer's information had been misused, and weighed the time and added cost AHP would face with new counsel. Bitdeer's Ohio counsel did not immediately comment, and AHP's firm welcomed the ruling. The underlying lease claims remain pending.

timeline.label: Bitdeer announces a 30-year lease from the Monroe County Port Authority at Hannibal Industrial Park in Clarington, Ohio
Bitdeer subsidiary Erie Creek LLC receives notice of AHP's complaint in the Monroe County Court of Common Pleas
Bitdeer moves to disqualify AHP's law firm over its work for Bitdeer in a separate New York case
Judge Julie Selmon denies Bitdeer's motion to disqualify AHP's counsel
